title: Abstention Direction in Large Language Models: Mechanistic Interpretability of Abstention Across Query Ambiguity, Knowledge Limits, and Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Abstention, the withholding of a response by a large language model (LLM) under uncertainty or safety risks, is essential for trustworthy models. The causes of abstention fall into three perspectives: ambiguity in the Query (Q), limits of Model Knowledge (MK), and misalignment with Human Values (HV). However, prior analyses of internal representations have focused on HV, using a refusal direction computed from harmful and harmless queries. No study has analyzed the three perspectives jointly. We therefore extend the refusal direction framework to all three perspectives. Specifically, for each perspective, we construct counterfactual pairs that share a template and differ only in the abstention-inducing factor, and compute an abstention direction by normalizing the difference in mean activations between the two polarities. translated_title: 大语言模型中的拒答方向：跨查询歧义、知识局限与安全对齐的拒答机制可解释性研究
translated_abstract: 拒答是指大语言模型（LLM）在面临不确定性或安全风险时拒绝给出回应，这对于构建可信赖的模型至关重要。拒答的成因可以从三个视角进行分析：查询本身的歧义性（Q）、模型知识的局限性（MK）以及与人类价值观（HV）的不一致。然而，以往对内部表征的分析仅集中于HV视角，即利用有害与无害查询计算出的拒绝方向，尚无研究对这三个视角进行联合分析。因此，本文将拒绝方向框架扩展至全部三个视角。具体而言，针对每个视角，我们构建了共享同一模板、仅在引发拒答的因素上存在差异的反事实配对样本，并通过归一化两种极性样本的平均激活差异来计算拒答方向。激活引导实验表明，对中间层进行干预可以在所有三类成因下增加或减少模型的拒答行为。
tldr: 该论文将原本仅针对安全对齐的拒绝方向框架扩展至查询歧义、知识局限与价值对齐三类拒答成因，通过反事实配对样本计算统一的拒答方向，并证明通过激活引导干预中间层可双向调控大语言模型的拒答行为。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the refusal direction framework beyond safety alignment to all three causes of LLM abstention—query ambiguity, knowledge limits, and value misalignment—by computing unified abstention directions from counterfactual pairs, showing that activation steering in middle layers can bidirectionally control abstention behavior.
